brand.name: Brand
brand.logo_light_info: Used on dark backgrounds, such as the footer and the transparent header over a hero image.
brand.share_image_info: Used when a page has no image of its own. 1200 x 630px works best.
brand.meta_description_info: Used on pages that have no description of their own, including the homepage. Aim for 150-160 characters.

colors.name: Colours
colors.intro: Five colours, five jobs. Each one means exactly one thing, and nothing borrows another's meaning. That discipline is what stops a competition site looking like a casino.
colors.ink_info: The darkest ground. Used for the hero and major moments.
colors.brand_info: The brand ground. Most dark surfaces on the site.
colors.accent_info: The thing you click, and nothing else. Never a badge, a bar or a heading.
colors.brass_info: Winners and achievement only. Deliberately never used for urgency, progress or calls to action — a gold meter filling up is the most recognisable cue in online gambling.

typography.name: Typography
typography.intro: Three faces, three jobs: a serif that carries the brand, a sans that gets out of the way, and a mono for anything a customer might want to verify.
typography.heading_case_info: Sentence case reads as confident. Uppercase everywhere reads as shouting, and flattens the hierarchy because nothing can be emphasised any further.
typography.mono_info: Entry counts, prices, draw numbers and dates are set in a monospaced face. Figures that line up read as precise and checkable, which is the point: the draw is the product.

layout.name: Layout
layout.spacing_intro: Sections choose one of three spacing tiers — major, standard or minor — derived from the value below. Uniform rhythm is what makes a page read as a list rather than a composition, so the tiers sit far apart on purpose.
layout.section_spacing_info: Major sections use 1.75 times this. Minor sections use half.
layout.card_shadow_info: None is the default. Let the photography define the object rather than a container around it.
layout.enable_motion_info: Hover and reveal transitions only. Nothing pulses, counts up or flashes. Always disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

competition.name: Competitions
competition.intro: Cards carry four things: the image, the prize, the entry price and the action. Everything else belongs on the competition page. Prize value, progress and closing dates only ever appear when the matching product metafield holds a real value.
competition.trim_prefix_info: Cards already sit under a heading that gives the context. Dropping the prefix returns the most visible line on the card to the prize itself.
competition.show_progress_info: Off by default. Progress belongs on the competition page, where there is room for it to be information rather than pressure.
competition.show_badges_info: One badge maximum, always. The most decision-relevant one wins.
competition.progress_intro: Progress is stated, never dramatised. The bar stays one neutral colour at every percentage, because the number is the information and the colour change is theatre.
competition.honesty_intro: Both of these state something about how your draw works. Leave them off until your competition rules say the same thing.
competition.show_odds_info: Shows "1 in N" on the competition page, calculated against the published entry cap. Only turn this on once your rules confirm the draw is made from the full set of issued entry numbers. Calculating against the cap is the worst case for the entrant, so a real chance can only be better.
competition.entry_numbers_issued: Entry numbers are issued to entrants
competition.entry_numbers_issued_info: Only turn this on once something actually allocates entry numbers and sends them. Nothing in Shopify does this by default, so leaving it off keeps the storefront from promising a number the entrant never receives.

cart.name: Cart
cart.show_recommendations: Show competition recommendations in the cart

search.name: Search
search.shortcuts_info: Shown before anyone types. Point it at your most popular competition categories.

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.intro: Connection points for systems outside Shopify. Leave a field empty and the related UI stays hidden rather than showing placeholder data.
integrations.analytics_enabled_info: Pushes a documented event set to window.dataLayer and fires greenside:analytics DOM events. See docs/ANALYTICS.md.
integrations.analytics_debug_info: For testing only. Turn off before launch.
integrations.progress_endpoint_info: Optional. A URL returning JSON entry counts so progress bars update live. Leave empty to use the product metafield values only. See docs/INTEGRATIONS.md.
integrations.referral_base_url_info: Leave empty until a referral provider is connected. The referral UI stays hidden while it is empty.

legal.name: Legal
legal.intro: Greenside is a UK prize competition business. Fill these in with wording confirmed by your legal adviser — the theme never invents legal claims.
legal.footer_text_info: Shown in the footer on every page. Include your company number and registered address.
legal.free_entry_url_info: Link to your postal or online free entry route. Shown on every competition page when set.
legal.min_age_info: Displayed as an eligibility note. Leave empty to hide.
legal.how_it_works_url_info: Used by empty states and help links when no competition is open.

all.heading: Heading
all.empty_intro: Shown instead of the heading above when this collection has no competitions in it, so the page never promises a number it cannot show.

contact.email_info: Leave empty to use the store's own contact email.
contact.details_info: Postal address, opening hours or how long a reply usually takes. Only state a response time you can keep.
